text:
emma: Heads-up — noticed a cluster of partner-batched reports that caused negative deltas in the hourly ledger for marketplace SKUs. Appears to be a late replay + duplicate batch id. Anyone else seeing weird credits? :wave:

rafi: Saw an alert from billing that net credits jumped for two accounts. Do we have the raw batched payload?

emma: Pasted one redacted batch below (kept short):
```json
{
  "batch_id": "batch-985ab",
  "partner_namespace": "acme-edge",
  "records": [
    {"device":"dev-A", "minute":"2026-03-21T23:00Z", "units": 10, "seq": 101},
    {"device":"dev-A", "minute":"2026-03-21T23:01Z", "units": -10, "seq": 101}
  ]
}
```
Note the duplicated seq + a negative units row (partner-level compensating delta). Our rollup treated both rows and ended up double-applying a credit.

leo: Negative compensating deltas are allowed but we require them to be tagged with original_tx_id so we can fold them idempotently. This payload is missing that field. Could be upstream connector bug.

partner_integration: We're pushing a patch to the edge connector that ensures compensating deltas include original_tx_id and that batch_id uniqueness is enforced client-side. ETA ~2h.

tina: Operational question: do we have a safe-mode reconciliation run that computes candidate corrections without touching money? We should not perform manual refunds until we've validated at scale.

emma: Yes — we have a "recon-dry" job. Proposal: run dry for this partner namespace across last 48h, emit candidate adjustments, surface flagged entries where batch_id reused or missing original_tx_id. After review, run "recon-apply" with idempotency guards and ledger-checksum.

rafi: Add to proposal: before apply, run a synthetic replay in a staging ledger to ensure balances converge. Also capture accounting journal export for audit.

billing_ops_bot: automated note — 13 ledger entries flagged as "duplicate-seq" in last hour. Ops runbook: https://go.redwood/recon/dup-seq-playbook

leo: Implementation details: 
- recon-dry should create a fixes table with columns: partner_namespace, batch_id, seq, original_payload_checksum, suggested_delta, reason, dry_run_id
- recon-apply will check ledger tx idempotency by original_payload_checksum and require 2-person approval for apply.

partner_integration: We'll add original_tx_id to the connector and a monotonic batch_id header. Also plan to emit a compact verification endpoint /v1/verify-batch which returns {expected_last_seq: N, seen_batch_ids: [...]} so partners can pre-check.

tina: Can we map out timeline? We need partner-facing comms if we're extending replay windows or asking them to re-send.

emma: Timeline draft: 
1) partner_integration ships connector patch + verify endpoint (2h)
2) recon-dry run by billing (1h)
3) staging replay + audit (2h)
4) partner comms sent after staging validates (tina to draft)

rafi: One more: add a quick check in the hourly rollup that rejects batches with duplicate seq within same batch_id (return 409 with body {"error":"duplicate_seq","hint":"include original_tx_id for compensating rows"}). That will prevent next-hour damage.

leo: +1. We'll ship a fail-fast rule behind a feature flag so we can toggle if partners need a soft landing.

tina: I'll draft the partner note: explain cause, ask for connector upgrade, include curl example to call /v1/verify-batch, and offer a short replay window extension (from 1h -> 3h) for this partner while they upgrade.

emma: Action items summary: 
• partner_integration: patch connector + add /v1/verify-batch (2h)
• leo: add duplicate-seq fail-fast rule behind FF (3h)
• billing: recon-dry + staging replay (3h)
• tina: partner comms draft + approval (1h)

emma: tagging @ops for temporary replay-window bump for namespace acme-edge. Do not apply billing corrections until recon-apply completes and audit export is attached. :lock:
